I'm putting together the structured output from the Korean delivery note: Hwaseong Memory's DN-261025-827 dated 2026.10.25, under PO 4500318718. It covers 70,000 pieces of the Game Card 128 GB, Grand Heist 6 edition, packed in 70 boxes, totaling 910 kg and shipped by Nordhav Shipping A/S.

I'm checking the stamp and signature for any corrections, and finding none, so I'll note the stamp and signature as observations rather than changes. The quantity reads as 70,000 under the Korean spacing convention, and the 910 kg weight works out to 13 kg per box across the 70 boxes. The document date is 2026.10.25, but there's no shipping date printed, so I won't invent one.
